title: Board Proximity Connect
description: Implement proximity connect: when dragging a node with no incident edges, overlapping another node's bounds shows a wire between nearest compatible handles (normal/detail/micro LOD only); release commits edge. Disabled in minimap and overview LOD.
summary: Proximity connect restored/extended: only considers handles on the overlapping peer node that have no incident edges (handle_has_incident_edge skip in best_proximity_compatible_handle_pair). Re-added DragNodes proximity_connect flow, LOD gate lod_allows_node_bounds_proximity_connect, preview wire, commit on release. Tests: base proximity, overview/minimap skip, node-with-edge skip, busy-only-other-handle skip, prefer free b:h1 when b:h0 linked.
